description:
Developed by KONAMI and evolved from PES, eFootball 2027 delivers a connected football experience across mobile with a focus on team building, match strategy, and live events. You start with a club or national side identity and progress through a guided onboarding designed for all skill levels. The game ties closely to the global eFootball ecosystem, so weekly updates and official events shape the way squads grow. Presentation can be tailored to match your style, and regular announcements keep the eFootball 2027 experience aligned with real football and esports. Therefore, it stays relevant season after season.


Key features of eFootball 2027

Learn with a guided tutorial and Smart Assist

eFootball 2027 walks you through movement, passing, and shooting with practical demos. Completing the tutorial grants a Lionel Messi item to begin building your squad. In addition, Smart Assist simplifies inputs while you get comfortable with the controls.

Start with your club or country

Select a favorite club or national team from Europe, the Americas, Asia, and more to set your identity. This choice influences early presentation and helps you feel at home right away. Moreover, your direction can evolve as you grow the squad.

Build and develop your Dream Team

Sign current superstars and football legends, then shape your eFootball 2027 roles across the pitch. Level players and allocate Progression Points manually or by using the Recommended option for efficiency. Therefore, your team improves steadily through matches and events.

Compete in AI matches and ranked online play

Practice tactics and test new signings in AI fixtures, then enter ranked play to measure your progress. Rewards from matches feed back into development and recruiting. Also, rotating eFootball 2027 events adds fresh goals regardless of your skill level.

Weekly Live Updates connected to real football

Each week, player form and transfers from the real season are reflected in eFootball 2027. This keeps lineups dynamic and encourages adjustments to maintain performance. Consequently, eFootball mobile remains aligned with ongoing football storylines.

Customize your stadium atmosphere

Use Tifos and Giant Props to create a unique home environment. Visuals and sounds reflect your choices to shape matchday energy. Furthermore, the presentation aligns with the broader eFootball ecosystem and special events.


eFootball 2027 community and esports

eFootball 2027 connects to the eFootball World Festival in Tokyo, a 30th Anniversary celebration of football gaming and esports. The eFootball Championship 2026 World Finals headline the program, with global live broadcasts in nine languages. In addition, major partner clubs such as FC Barcelona and Manchester United participate through club events that bring fans closer to the action.

The festival also highlights fan-facing activities, including influencer showcases, a Friend Match Arena for casual play, and a photo card booth for memorabilia. You can follow recaps, galleries, and announcements on the official site for updates tied to new content and licensing. Therefore, the app remains closely linked to real-world football culture and competitive play.


30th Anniversary rewards and account linking in eFootball 2027

During the 30th Anniversary period, special rewards such as Big Time: 30th Anniversary Chance Deal and a Special Selection Contract are available for a limited time. To receive these, you must link your KONAMI ID to your eFootball account. Once linked, campaign items are delivered to eligible accounts during the event window, subject to the in-game notices. This approach keeps rewards secure and tied to your progress across devices.

eFootball 2027 offers deeper player customization and more realistic stadiums, while FIFA Mobile is preferred for its broader licensing and more casual gameplay style.

Advantages:

  • Highly detailed graphics and animations.​
  • Customizable team-building options.​
  • Frequent updates for player data and game features.​

Disadvantages:

  • Higher device resource requirements.
  • Occasional lag or compatibility issues on older phones.​


How to start playing eFootball 2027

This quick guide helps you move from your first launch to your first ranked match. It focuses on setup, early team building, and basic competition flow inside eFootball 2027.

1. Download eFootball 2027 latest version on APKPure and follow the on-screen instructions to install the game on your Android device.

2. Launch eFootball 2027, set your language, and choose your starting club or national team to define your identity.

3. Complete the tutorial with its practical demos to learn core controls and secure the Lionel Messi reward. Enable Smart Assist if you want simpler inputs.

After that, you can begin strengthening your lineup and testing tactics with minimal friction.

4. Open the Contract or Sign menu to recruit players, then allocate Progression Points manually or use the Recommended option to level efficiently.

5. Play a few AI matches to try formations, set-piece takers, and roles until you settle on a basic game plan.

Then move to competitive play and event participation to keep growing your squad.

6. Enter ranked online matches when ready, and check Events for timed objectives. Customize stadium Tifos and Giant Props, and link your KONAMI ID from Settings to receive eligible campaign rewards.

FAQs

How do I claim the 30th Anniversary rewards in eFootball 2027?

To receive limited-time items such as Big Time: 30th Anniversary Chance Deal and the Special Selection Contract, link your KONAMI ID to your eFootball account from the in-game settings. After linking, rewards are delivered during the campaign period based on eligibility. Check your in-game inbox and notices for exact timing and details-

What is the eFootball World Festival and why does it matter for eFootball 2027?

The eFootball World Festival in Tokyo marks the 30th Anniversary of KONAMI football games and hosts the eFootball Championship 2027 World Finals. It features live broadcasts in nine languages and club involvement from partners such as FC Barcelona and Manchester United. These activities tie into announcements about new content and licensing that keep eFootball 2027 evolving.

How do Weekly Live Updates impact my players in eFootball 2027?

Weekly Live Updates mirror real football form and transfers, so player performance and availability in eFootball 2027 reflect the current season. This affects squad choices, chemistry, and event strategies. You may need to adjust lineups each week to maintain consistency in both AI and ranked matches.
